integrity: All stated exact constants are supported by a complete analytic piecewise-linear proof; rational experiments independently corroborate finite cases. No external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: For one simultaneous closed-neighborhood median step on finite simple unweighted stars only. Edge variation weights must be positive; filter samples are unweighted and even windows use the midpoint of the two central observations. No claim on general trees, iterates or other tie rules. Prior literature comparison is nonexhaustive; full text of the 1994 smoothing paper was unavailable. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp weighted edge-variation stability of closed-neighborhood medians on stars
